title: On video: Riyad Mahrez revives memories of Al-Ahli magic with a brace against Al-Hilal
text:
On video: Riyad Mahrez revives memories of Al-Ahli magic with a brace against Al-Hilal Scores News Favourites Home Football Predictions Premier League Daily News Roundups Promotions NFL NBA Golf Horse Racing Cricket Darts On video: Riyad Mahrez revives memories of Al-Ahli magic with a brace against Al-Hilal
 GOAL The Algerian star continues to shine
 Riyad Mahrez revived some magical memories against Al-Hilal. The Algeria and Al-Gharafa winger tormented his old rivals in the AFC Champions League Elite, just as he used to with Al-Ahli of Saudi Arabia.
 Al-Hilal travelled to Al-Gharafa on Tuesday at the Al Bayt Stadium in Al Khor, in the third round of the league stage of the Asian tournament.
 Mahrez teed up Al-Gharafa's second in the 48th minute. He whipped in a low cross and compatriot Baghdad Bounedjah turned it past goalkeeper Mohammed Al-Owais.
 He wasn't done there. From a free kick, the Algerian star floated a cross onto the head of Tunisian midfielder Mohamed Ali Ben Romdhane, who nodded it into Al-Hilal's net in the 54th minute.
 It was the second time Mahrez has set up two goals against Al-Hilal. The first came with Al-Ahli in September of last year, when the sides drew 3-3 in the third round of the Roshn League.
 That assist took his tally to six against Al-Hilal, in his tenth meeting with them across all competitions since joining Al-Ahli in the summer of 2023.
